reply.text:
I can't give you a green light on that, and I won't put numbers on it. Pre-workouts are mostly stimulants, usually caffeine plus a handful of other ingredients, and stacking two means you're doubling everything on both labels without really knowing the total. That's the part worth taking seriously, so the amount that's right for you is a question for a doctor or dietitian, especially if you're sensitive to caffeine or take any medication.

What I can say from the training side is that none of it replaces sleep, a meal a couple of hours before, and a decent warm-up. If you're feeling like one isn't doing enough, that's usually a sign to look at those first. Want me to set up today's session?
